title: SkyrimNet Dialogue Scenario Editor
tagline: Write scenarios that nearby NPCs play out - narration, lines spoken in their own voice, OStim scenes - or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you with SkyrimNet's AI.
description:
**For adult players.** Scenarios can end in sex scenes (OStim or SexLab).

Write short scenarios that real NPCs play out when you meet them: who takes part, what the situation is, who says what, and how each part ends. Or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you. SkyrimNet's AI speaks every line in the speaker's own voice, so the same scenario fits any character.

## Scenarios in columns
A scenario has up to 10 columns, played from left to right. Each column has 1 to 3 people (the player too), a narration that sets the situation, up to 10 lines in any order (anyone may speak several times), and what ends the column: nothing (talk only), a sex scene with the tags you pick (OStim, or SexLab P+ / 1.6x), on a nearby bed if you like, ending the scene the people are in, move and wait (chosen people walk to an interior and wait there until another scenario has happened or some days have passed), or a SkyrimNet action one of them does (from the mods you have installed, such as SeverActions). The same person may appear in several columns; a column with one person can be a masturbation scene.

## Lines in the speaker's own voice
A line is not read out word for word: SkyrimNet is told that the speaker is about to say something that means it, and the AI words it the way that character would. Your own lines are spoken by your character through SkyrimNet.

## Auto lines
Switch a single line to Auto, or a whole column (Short 3, Medium 6, Long 10 lines): the AI makes those lines up when they are spoken, from the column's narration, the columns before and after, and the talk so far.

## Generate
Pick a scenario writer (an NPC), 2 to 10 people (NPCs and you), the number of columns and, if you like, a theme. The writer writes every column in their own style: the people of each column, the narration, the lines with their speakers, and where a sex scene fits, with tags. It draws on the people's bios, memories, recent events and latest diary entries, and on the relationship maps of SN Sexual Memories when there are any. Generate (auto lines) writes only the people, narration and sex scenes of each column and leaves the lines to Auto. Its model: AI > Models, dialogue_scenario_writer.

## When it starts
Automatically when everyone in it is near you, or when you press the scenario hotkey (set in the MCM), your choice per scenario. You also choose who else may be around; indoors, outdoors or one cell; once or every few days; and a scenario that must come first.

## How a column plays
The people walk over to you and stay together while they talk; anyone who does not arrive within a few seconds is moved over. Then the column's end follows, and the next column begins once whoever is talking has finished. People who are fighting, in a scene, or busy with what an action started are left to it: they talk from where they are. Leaving the place stops the scenario; it counts as not having happened.

## Sex scenes
The scene that fits the tags best is chosen: all of them first, then the tags that say what happens, and a scene that only shares a mood tag last. On a bed, the scene plays on the nearest free bed, and when you take part everyone is moved onto it first. When the same people are still in a scene from the column before, the scene goes on and only the animation changes. Excluded scenes (an editor list, empty at first) are never picked; the log names each scene just before it starts.

## Settings page
Made and changed on an in-game page (Magelight UI or Prisma UI), opened with a key you set in the MCM. Its size can be set from 70 to 200 %. Scenarios are saved as files, the same for every save; whether one has already happened is kept in the save, shown in the editor, and can be cleared there.

## When something goes wrong
The mod writes what it does to SKSE\SkyrimNet_DialogueScenarioEditor.log in Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition: why a scenario is not starting, and while one runs, every line, SkyrimNet's speech events and each sex scene. It is made new at every game start.

## Requirements
SKSE64, Address Library, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, OStim Standalone or SexLab (P+ or 1.6x) for sex scenes (either one; without them the talk, move and wait and actions still work), PapyrusUtil SE, powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, MCM Helper, SkyUI, and Magelight UI or Prisma UI for the settings page. SN Sexual Memories is optional.

## Known limits
Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with Magelight UI and OStim; the Prisma UI page has not been tested in game yet. SexLab P+ is tested, but not yet its bed choice or the animation change between columns; SexLab 1.6x is supported but not tested in game. An NPC sitting in a chair may not stand up to walk over and is moved over instead. SkyrimNet itself can pick actions from what the narration and lines say, apart from the column-end action, more so with auto lines: to have an action happen exactly where you put it, let the narration lead up to it and let the column-end action start it.
